IMAGE-GNM surface runoff and erosion factors.

Source: R/datasets_balances.R
image_gnm_runoff_factors.Rd

The factors of IMAGE-GNM's surface runoff nitrogen (Beusen et al. 2015, eqs. 8-9, p. 4052), read by calculate_n_leaching() with method = "image_gnm":

  • runoff_land_use: f_qsro(landuse) of eq. 3 (p. 4049), the land-use factor of the surface runoff fraction, as listed with its standard values in Table 3 (p. 4056).

  • erosion_texture: the texture factor of the erodibility, from the authors' fix_input/texture_erosion.vat.

  • soil_loss: the soil loss per km2 and year per unit erodibility of each land use, from the authors' parameter file. The paper prints only the European means these were calibrated to (360, 40 and 15 t per km2 for arable land, grassland and natural vegetation, p. 4052).

  • erosion_cn: the C:N ratio of eroded soil (p. 4052).

The paper sets the soil loss of peat soils equal to that of fine texture (p. 4052); the authors' table gives peat 0.5 and fine 1.5, and the table, the one their results came from, is used.

Usage

image_gnm_runoff_factors

Format

A tibble with columns:

factor

"runoff_land_use", "erosion_texture", "soil_loss" or "erosion_cn".

class

Land use "Cropland", "Grassland" or "Natural", or the texture classes of image_gnm_leaching_factors ("coarse", "medium", "fine", "very_fine", "organic").

value

The factor.

unit

Its unit.

source

Locator of the value.

Source

Beusen, A. H. W., Van Beek, L. P. H., Bouwman, A. F. et al. (2015). Coupling global models for hydrology and nutrient loading to simulate nitrogen and phosphorus retention in surface water - description of IMAGE-GNM and analysis of performance. Geosci. Model Dev. 8, 4045-4067. doi:10.5194/gmd-8-4045-2015 . Table 3 (p. 4056) for runoff_land_use and p. 4052 for erosion_cn. The authors' model code and inputs published with the paper, doi:10.5194/gmd-8-4045-2015-supplement : N_model/trunk/tools/parameters_history_100.ini lines 112-121 and 213-215, and fix_input/texture_erosion.vat.

Examples

image_gnm_runoff_factors
#> # A tibble: 14 × 5
#>    factor          class        value unit                                source
#>    <chr>           <chr>        <dbl> <chr>                               <chr> 
#>  1 runoff_land_use Cropland     1     dimensionless                       Beuse…
#>  2 runoff_land_use Grassland    0.25  dimensionless                       Beuse…
#>  3 runoff_land_use Natural      0.125 dimensionless                       Beuse…
#>  4 erosion_texture coarse       0.5   dimensionless                       IMAGE…
#>  5 erosion_texture medium       1.5   dimensionless                       IMAGE…
#>  6 erosion_texture fine         1.5   dimensionless                       IMAGE…
#>  7 erosion_texture very_fine    0.5   dimensionless                       IMAGE…
#>  8 erosion_texture organic      0.5   dimensionless                       IMAGE…
#>  9 soil_loss       Cropland  1151     t soil km-2 yr-1 per unit erodibil… IMAGE…
#> 10 soil_loss       Grassland   99     t soil km-2 yr-1 per unit erodibil… IMAGE…
#> 11 soil_loss       Natural     29     t soil km-2 yr-1 per unit erodibil… IMAGE…
#> 12 erosion_cn      Cropland    12     g C g-1 N                           Beuse…
#> 13 erosion_cn      Grassland   14     g C g-1 N                           Beuse…
#> 14 erosion_cn      Natural     14     g C g-1 N                           Beuse…
